context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 tested the complete Password Reset flow via Google Workspace SMTP email. Backend endpoints tested: POST /api/auth/forgot-password, GET /api/auth/verify-reset-token, POST /api/auth/reset-password. Frontend pages tested: /admin (forgot password link), /admin/forgot-password, /admin/reset-password. All CRUD operations and validations work correctly. Reset tokens are stored in MongoDB 'password_resets' collection with TTL index. SMTP email is REAL (sends via Google Workspace contact@rpmautomotivesc.com).
